features.title: Android client for the harness
features.what: The app runs the harness on the phone or connects to a desktop one.
features.evidence_quote: An Android client for DeepSeek Harness. Run DSH right on your phone, or drive the one on your computer.

features.title: Runtime installed inside the app
features.what: Ubuntu, Node.js and the harness install from the app itself.
features.evidence_quote: install Ubuntu, Node.js and DSH from the app without Root or a separate Termux installation.

features.title: Interrupt and fold steps
features.what: You can send while it replies, and finished steps collapse.
features.evidence_quote: Finished steps fold into one line.

features.title: Phone control, gated
features.what: With permissions the engine reads the screen and taps; sensitive steps wait.
features.evidence_quote: DSH reads the screen and taps for you. Sensitive actions stay with you by default

features.title: Remote mode has limits
features.what: Remoting into a computer accepts images only and drops the in-app web view.
features.evidence_quote: DSHarness Remote currently accepts image attachments only, does not open the web interface inside the app

features.title: Android only for now
features.what: The app ships for Android; other platforms are announced, not shipped.
features.evidence_quote: iOS and HarmonyOS versions are coming as soon as I can make them.

risks.text: Android only: iOS and HarmonyOS are announced, not released.
Remote mode accepts image attachments only and does not open the web interface inside the app.
